name: regards-design
description: Website inspiration by look: real, well-made website sections, searched by mood, type, colour, motion and how experimental they are, shown as screenshots in the chat.

interface.longDescription:
regards.design is a hand-picked library of real, well-made websites, cut into their sections (heroes, navigation, feature grids, pricing, footers and more), each screenshotted and searchable by how it looks: its mood, type, colour, imagery, motion and how experimental it is.

Ask the way you'd brief a designer: "experimental hero sections with striking type", "calm, minimal heroes with lots of white space", "design studio homepages that move". The sections that fit appear as screenshots in the chat. Open any of them on regards.design, see the rest of the page it came from, or ask for more like the ones you like.

Reach for it while the look of a website is still open: setting a visual direction for a brand, designing or redesigning a landing page, or finding references for a single section.

Making the page in Codex or another coding agent? The regards design skill (regards.design/skill) takes it further: it researches real sections for your brief, settles a direction, designs the page and checks it in a browser.

Sign in with your regards.design account to search.
capabilities: Search website sections by mood, type, colour, motion and novelty
Show sections as screenshots in the chat
Find sections like the ones you choose
Show every section of a page in order
defaultPrompt: Find experimental hero sections with striking type
Show me design studio homepages that move
Find calm, minimal heroes with lots of white space

positive.prompt: Find experimental hero sections with striking type.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a row of hero sections from real websites whose type is unusual (oversized, distorted, collaged or set in 3D) as screenshots. Each card opens the section on regards.design, and the reply picks out the few that fit best.

positive.prompt: Show me design studio homepages that move.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows hero sections from design studios' homepages that animate (looping video, moving galleries, 3D scenes) as screenshots, and the reply says what moves in each.

positive.description: Widen from a section the user liked
positive.prompt: Find calm, minimal hero sections with lots of white space, then show me more like the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: After the first search, finds sections that look like the first result and shows them as a new row of screenshots.

positive.prompt: Show me every section of Linear's homepage, top to bottom.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Linear's homepage and shows its sections in page order (hero, logos, features and so on down to the footer) as screenshots.

positive.prompt: Find hero sections with a quiet, editorial feel for a ceramics studio. Look closely at the best two and suggest a direction for our homepage.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches, views the screenshots of the two strongest results, and proposes a direction for type, colour, imagery and layout grounded in what those sections actually show.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: General coding question with no design to look up
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that removes duplicates from a list.

negative.description: Writing task with nothing visual to find
negative.prompt: Translate this sentence into French: the meeting moved to Thursday.

review.commerce_description: regards.design doesn't sell anything in ChatGPT or Codex.

publication.release_notes: First release: search real website sections by how they look and see them as screenshots in the chat, open them on regards.design, and find more like the ones you choose.
